query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) as total_salarios,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_salario 
WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1);
